title: Universal TV Remote
shortDescription: Wi-Fi remote for compatible Android TV and Google TV devices.
fullDescription:
Use your Android phone as a Wi-Fi remote for a compatible Android TV or Google TV. Keep your phone and TV on the same home Wi-Fi network, find your TV, and enter the six-character pairing code shown on its screen.

FAMILIAR TV CONTROLS

Navigate with direction buttons and OK, return with Home and Back, and use volume and mute controls when supported by your TV. Switch to a directional touchpad to navigate with swipes.

YOUR SAVED CONNECTIONS

Save and rename your paired TVs so you can choose them again. Choose a light or dark appearance and turn haptic feedback on or off.

No advertising. No app account required. TV commands stay on your local network. Optional app update checks and downloads use Google Play and require internet access.

COMPATIBILITY AND SETUP

Requires a compatible Android TV or Google TV with the Android TV Remote Service available. Your TV must be set up, powered on and reachable from the phone's local Wi-Fi network. This app is not an infrared remote and does not support every smart TV platform.

Available volume, media and power controls depend on your TV, firmware and active TV app. Standby and wake behavior varies; waking a TV is not guaranteed. TV keyboard input is currently unavailable.

Universal TV Remote is an independent app and is not affiliated with Google or TV manufacturers.
